mentions.name: PCB milling software tool
mentions.description: A PCB milling tool that converts Gerber files into G-code toolpaths and commands a restored 1998 PCB mill, enabling hobbyists to fabricate PCBs at home instead of waiting on outsourced fabrication.
mentions.problem: Getting PCB designs back from services like PCBWay/JLC between customers is a headache due to tariffs and shipping delays, slowing the prototyping loop.
mentions.audience: Hobbyists who want to make PCBs at home as part of the self-made PCB workflow.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a PCB milling software tool that combines converting Gerbers to toolpaths in G-Code and then actually commanding and operating a restored PCB mill from 1998.

evidence.value: Building a PCB milling software tool that combines converting Gerbers to toolpaths in G-Code and then actually commanding and operating a restored PCB mill from 1998.
